description: Stormwater — Pipe — Existing is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This information provides a graphical representation of the locations of the existing (as constructed) stormwater pipes in the Brisbane City Council local government area. It can be combined with other Stormwater data to provide the entire Stormwater Network. Not all assets within the network are owned, and maintained by Brisbane City Council. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Assets and Facilities. Its keywords are arcgis, assets, environment, stormwater, pipe, drain. The portal shows 292,188 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
